title: NBN POI 2CFS (Coffs Harbour), 2MIR (Miranda), 2GRN (Grafton) - Fibre Splicing Works
current_summary: Planned fibre splicing work affecting NBN services in Coffs Harbour, Miranda, and Grafton (POIs 2CFS, 2MIR, 2GRN) has been completed. The maintenance ran from Thursday, 13 August at 11:00 PM to Friday, 14 August at 7:00 AM AEST. If you are still experiencing any issues, please contact our support team.

If you have issues after the window ends, please contact our support team.
